prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, immutable canonical faces. First inputs canonical identity portraits, next LAB room reference only, LAST exact target. Preserve exact people, adult ages, facial morphology, expressions, hairstyle, signature equipment, natural warm skin, body poses, every connected shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chain, grips, neck alignment, chairs and contacts. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye, Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear, Nazari has NO eyewear. Keep story action dominant. Every unmentioned monitor and wrist display OFF, plain charcoal glass. No arbitrary graph, wave, code, bars or meters. Keep restrained sage, aged brass and charcoal. Remove neon mint rims and broad yellow/gold wash. The tall glass LAB PILLAR must become dark muted sage with thin dim grey internal bands, never glowing lime. Natural warm lamp light. Preserve Demir face, whole head size, two supported arms, pinch gesture and seated posture. Main left monitor headed "Synthetic training fixture" with three short lines "72 rows", "8 features per row", "Exclude flagged rows before fit". The small translucent card between his fingers reads "flagged" and sits outside the training input path, not going into the model. Right monitor shows "8 / 4 / 2 / 4 / 8" under "Layer widths", then "Same rows: input and target", then "Held-out MSE: pending". One upper monitor shows only "400 epochs, batch 16". No learner result, no success symbol, no random waveforms. All other displays and wrist screen off. Clean bold adventure-comic linework, flat cel shading, balanced stylized adults. Output one 1536x1024 scene.
